description: A wicker basket of assorted fruit sits on a red tablecloth, with a gray plate to the right holding a toy burger, a green pear, and a few dark grapes. The left hand reaches from the right toward the basket, grasps a bunch of red grapes as a left-hand object, lifts them up and over to the plate, then lowers and releases them onto the plate near the other items while the right hand stays out of view.
